scope: all rational maps u=U(x), v=c*y with deg U=deg F/deg G, plus exact geometric map count
timing: Serial fresh processes. Solver timer starts after imports and includes curve validation, coefficient construction, elimination, extraction of all rational maps and exact curve identities. Process wall includes interpreter startup.
order: Two seeded shuffles of every case/method pair, seed 76124.
baseline: Singular receives the raw coefficient ideal G(U)=F*c^2 with inverse*u_d=1 and uses heuristic groebner in dp, radical and FGLM. SymPy decomposition uses the fixed-degree Kozen-style dense routines underlying public decompose, followed by the same residual affine equations and rational extraction as the project.
correctness: All complete outputs must agree on exact geometric count and the entire sorted list of rational maps. Every rational map satisfies the original source-target identity.
shared_extraction: Both specialized decompositions use the same exact rational-point engine. No CREST_SINGULAR override is set in the published study; that residual engine uses SymPy.
